# Third-party notices

Bobine is licensed under the Apache License 2.0 (see `LICENSE` and `NOTICE`). The app ships the
third-party software listed below; each component keeps its own license. This file ships with the
app, next to Bobine's `LICENSE` and `NOTICE`: `Bobine.app/Contents/Resources/licenses/` on macOS,
`resources/licenses/` on Linux.

## Electron and Chromium

Bobine runs on [Electron](https://www.electronjs.org) 45.2.3 (MIT, license text
[T1](#t1)), which embeds Chromium, Node.js and their components. Their licenses are in
`LICENSES.chromium.html`, shipped with the app in `licenses/electron/` together with Electron's
`LICENSE`.

## npm packages shipped in the app

188 packages, copied into the app by the build (`out/`: main process,
interface) or added by the packager (production dependencies, `app.asar`). Development tools
that ship nothing (compilers, test runners, linters, the packager itself) are not listed; Vite
and Rolldown are, for the small runtime helpers they add to the build output.

## Dual-licensed packages: license chosen

- **dompurify 3.4.17** is offered under `(MPL-2.0 OR Apache-2.0)`; Bobine distributes it under **Apache-2.0**. It is not modified. Source code: https://github.com/cure53/DOMPurify (version 3.4.17).
- **elkjs 0.12.1** is offered under `EPL-2.0 OR GPL-3.0-or-later`; Bobine distributes it under **EPL-2.0**. It is not modified. Source code: https://github.com/kieler/elkjs (version 0.12.1).

## AXe and idb (macOS app only)

[AXe](https://github.com/cameroncooke/AXe) 1.8.0 (iOS Simulator automation: taps, screen
reading, video), MIT — Copyright (c) 2025 Cameron Cooke, ships in `Contents/Resources/axe` with
the [idb](https://github.com/facebook/idb) frameworks it bundles (FBControlCore, FBDeviceControl,
XCTestBootstrap), MIT — Copyright (c) Meta Platforms, Inc. and affiliates. Their full license texts
ship with them: `Contents/Resources/axe/LICENSES.txt` (in the repository:
`vendor/archives/AXe-1.8.0-LICENSES.txt`).

## MesloLGS Nerd Font

One font is embedded: MesloLGS Nerd Font Regular, from the
[Nerd Fonts](https://github.com/ryanoasis/nerd-fonts) release v3.5.1, used
by the terminal panel only for icons missing from the other fonts. The font file is shipped as
published, unmodified.

- Meslo LG (Copyright 2009, 2010, 2013 André Berg), Apache-2.0: [T81](#t81).
- Nerd Fonts patcher (Copyright (c) 2014 Ryan L McIntyre), MIT: [T82](#t82).
- Icon sets merged into the font by Nerd Fonts, each under its own license (table from the font's
  README):

| Icon set name          | upstream                                              | version         | license     |
|------------------------|-------------------------------------------------------|-----------------|-------------|
| Codicons               | https://github.com/microsoft/vscode-codicons          | 0.0.45          | CC BY 4.0   |
| Devicons               | https://github.com/devicons/devicon                   | 2.17.0          | MIT         |
| extraglyphs            | https://github.com/source-foundry/Hack                | -               | MIT         |
| Font Awesome           | https://github.com/FortAwesome/Font-Awesome           | 6.5.1           | CC BY 4.0   |
| Font Awesome Extension | https://github.com/AndreLZGava/font-awesome-extension | 0.0.3           | MIT         |
| Font Logos             | https://github.com/lukas-w/font-logos                 | 1.3.0           | unlicensed  |
| MaterialDesign         | https://github.com/Templarian/MaterialDesign-Font     | Oct 6, 2022     | Apache 2.0  |
| Octicons               | https://github.com/primer/octicons                    | 18.3.0          | MIT         |
| Seti and original      | https://github.com/jesseweed/seti-ui                  | 0.8.1           | MIT         |
| Pomicons               | https://github.com/gabrielelana/pomicons              | 1.001           | OFL 1.1 RFN |
| Powerline Extra        | https://github.com/ryanoasis/powerline-extra-symbols  | 1.200           | MIT         |
| Powerline Symbols      | https://github.com/powerline/powerline                | 1.000 (ca 2013) | MIT         |
| Power Symbols IEC      | https://github.com/jloughry/Unicode                   | Feb 2015        | MIT         |
| Weather Icons          | https://github.com/erikflowers/weather-icons          | 2.0.10 (1.100)  | OFL 1.1     |

Attributions. The Codicons glyphs are © Microsoft Corporation and the Font Awesome glyphs are
© Fonticons, Inc. (https://fontawesome.com); both are licensed under the Creative Commons
Attribution 4.0 International license (https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/,
[T83](#t83)). Nerd Fonts rescaled and repositioned these glyphs to fit the font; Bobine
does not modify them further. Pomicons (Reserved Font Name "Pomicons") and Weather Icons are
licensed under the SIL Open Font License 1.1 ([T84](#t84)). The other icon sets are under
the licenses listed in the table.

## Interface fonts, icons and artwork

- **Fonts**: the interface uses the system fonts of macOS (SF Pro, New York, SF Mono) through
  generic CSS families; nothing is embedded besides the font above.
- **Icons**: [Lucide](https://lucide.dev) (`lucide-react`, listed above).
- **App icon** (`build/icon.svg`) and **install background** (`build/background.svg`): the
  project's own work, under Bobine's license.

## Not bundled

IBM Bob and OpenCode are separate programs installed by the user; Bobine starts them over ACP
(Agent Client Protocol) and embeds nothing of theirs.

## License texts

Identical texts are printed once. When a package ships a NOTICE file, it follows its license,
after a `---` line.
